what_happened.line: The board voted 4-1 to keep its current town counsel and labor counsel and not issue a request for proposals.
The board accepted the town manager's FY20 goals as presented, with minor adjustments, by unanimous vote.
The board voted to ask Unitil for an updated price to buy the street lights for LED conversion.
The board began its own FY20 goals, mostly about town buildings, and did not settle any of them.
The board cancelled the July 2 meeting and put the committee liaison discussion on the first meeting of August.

why_it_matters: Legal costs for labor matters stay with the current hourly arrangement and were not put out to competitive bid, so the town budget, mostly taxes, continues to carry that cost.
An updated Unitil purchase price is the figure the town needs before deciding whether to buy the street lights and convert them to LED, which affects future electricity and maintenance costs.
The board's own goals, mostly about town buildings, are still unsettled, so spending priorities for those buildings are not yet set.
